source.check: names from the Derry Journal's list of nominations ('Councillor ...') and the Returning Officer's notice of result (Derry Journal, 19 May 1961, p. 13: no poll taken, the fifteen declared elected); party by ward as the Journal's report states

note: Triennial election of the fifteen councillors of Londonderry Corporation, due Wednesday 17 May 1961: no contest. At the close of nominations on Wednesday 3 May six Nationalists were returned unopposed for the South Ward, six Unionists for the North Ward and three Unionists for the Waterside (Derry Journal, 5 May 1961). The Independent Labour Group decided not to contest. Names as in the Returning Officer's notice; Anderson's other names are partly illegible in the OCR (initials A. W. in the Derry Journal's nomination report). Returned unopposed.
